libs.note: BH-8417 (scope F). One line per GitHub event (merged, opened, closed, push, ci) of one repo since --since, read through gh_rest (ETag cache). A failed read prints UNREADABLE and exits 75; the page cap prints INCOMPLETE. Reader: archie_repo_activity_block (bin/lib/archie-repo-activity.sh). Applied by bin/repo-activity.sh through lib_env_apply; the code literal is the documented fallback.

knobs.note: Pages of 100 read per endpoint (pulls, actions/runs) per run. Past it the script prints `INCOMPLETE <endpoint> pages=<n>` and lists only what it read. Code fallback 5 in bin/repo-activity.sh; outside 1..50 is one stderr line and the default.
